actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is below 30%, so increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, resulting in full wallet contribution. Broadcast norm as required every 5 rounds.

message.reasoning:
We need to pick actions for round 5. Wallet 121.72. Baseline 80% = 97.376. Average contribution? Compute total contributions each round sum contributions: round1 total 240, round2 432, round3 271.2, round4 410.88. Average per round = (240+432+271.2+410.88)/4 = 135.52. Endowment per round total possible 600. So average % = 135.52/600 = 22.59% which is below 30%. So rule: if avg <30%, increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. So contribution = baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet but cannot exceed wallet. So we contribute full wallet 121.72. Also check conserve rule: wallet >50% so not reduce. So action contribute amount 121.72.

Punish? Need detect any agent with <10% for two consecutive rounds. Look at contributions: Resident3 gave 60,60,60,60 all >10. Resident1 gave 20,60,0,0 -> round3 and 4 are 0 (<10) two consecutive -> should punish Resident1 amount 10 (severity). Cost 3 (0.3*10). We have enough wallet. So we can punish one agent. But we already have physical action contribute; can only one physical action. So must choose either contribute or punish. Must contribute per constitution. So no punish this round.

Communication: round 5 is multiple of 5? rounds start at 1, we are at round 5, need broadcast norm. So broadcast message.

Thus actions list two: contribute and broadcast.
